title.narrative: Sustainability of services for key populations in the Caribbean Phase 2 - Americas - Multicountry Caribbean CARICOM-PANCAP (01-Oct-2022-30-Sep-2025)

description.narrative: Multicountry Caribbean CARICOM-PANCAP, HIV, Caribbean Community (CARICOM) (CARICOM)This program has the following goals: To provide sustainable prevention, treatment and care services for key populations in the Caribbean. The objectives of this program are: To increase domestic resources for effective key population programming. To mobilise resources for Key population organisations. To reduce barriers to key population services (including stigma and discrimination and gender-based violence). To improve knowledge generation and use of strategic information on key populations for decision-making and advocacy by Communities and other stakeholders
